A '''comlink encoder''' was used to protect [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmissions. It was an integrated system in the [[Multi-channel Comm Unit]] used in [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1 power armor|AV-1 series]] of [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]].
